page.overview:
Who is Black Hat?

Black Hat is a character in the G.I. Joe Real American Hero comics from IDW and Skybound.

Black Hat is a member of G.I. Joe and a computer hacking specialist.

Black Hat grew up in Pacific Palisades, and was a computer nerd from one. Her father was a digital artist who worked in TV post-production, and her mother was an IT specialist at a major software firm, so computers were always part of her life. She was the youngest person to receive a Master of Computer Science degree from MIT. She got her U.S. Navy commission through the ROTC program, and went directly into the Cyber Warfare Engineering program. Jump qualified. Qualified expert with M16A2 5.56mm rifle, M14 EBR 7.62 assault rifle, and M11 9mm pistol. Fluent in Russian, Mandarin, Farsi and Klingon.[https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=10159590103918279&set=pcb.10159590104113279|1]
